text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While searching around for Daring Heart, 
who hadn't shown up despite it being time 
for training—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the spirit! Aiming to be cool 
is great and all, but first you gotta set 
your heart on fire!

text_block_list.name: Children
choice_data_list: It's quite a full house, Dr. Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it? Even though it's an 
impromptu dance class, everyone is so 
motivated... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! I completely lost track of 
time. I'll be much more careful next 
time...!
